purpose: Contact-relative landing coordinate (mission section 3), implemented in scripts/relative_timing.py

usage.seeding: scripts.relative_timing.seed_absolute_delay(params) runs the candidate's own unpowered (retro disabled at 200s) descent to get its own t_unpowered_ground_contact, then returns absolute_delay_seed = t_unpowered_ground_contact - REFERENCE_TAU_FREE_CONTACT_S as the starting point for a LOCAL delay sweep on that candidate -- not a final answer, since the legal basin is ~2ms wide and non-monotonic at millisecond scale (corrected-phase4c-record.json).
usage.serialization: The absolute XML ignitiondelay (ignitionevent=launch) is only computed at ORK-generation time, from whatever tau/seed value won the local sweep for that specific candidate -- never reused verbatim across candidates.
usage.why_mandatory: A sustainer mutation changes total separated vehicle mass, separation velocity/attitude, and hence the booster's own natural (unpowered) hang time -- this is the root cause already proven for the literal-33.104s failure (2.76s natural-hang-time mismatch against a different sustainer's implied mass). Reusing 29.864s absolute for a new sustainer candidate repeats that exact failure mode.
